2.explanation: The root issue lives in the ActionableNotification function component in Notification.js. Although its propTypes declare caption: PropTypes.string, the component’s JSX does not read or output the caption prop anywhere. To fix the bug, the render logic inside ActionableNotification must be updated to include the caption value in the DOM (e.g. alongside the subtitle), so that passing the caption prop produces visible text.
2.bug_scenario: The ActionableNotification component accepts a caption prop (e.g. a timestamp or subtitle) but never renders it.
